facts: The installed product has the com.openai.codex identifier at the ChatGPT.app path.
The renderer uses React 19.2.7 and the installed application CSS, fonts and icons.
The renderer's browser host creates a native webview element with an about:blank bootstrap URL.
The primary macOS window uses titleBarStyle hiddenInset, menu vibrancy and acceptFirstMouse.
Host services use the renderer's own MessageChannel RPC implementation; the fixture supplies synthetic service targets.
Original renderer assets remain in temporary workspaces and are absent from the repository.

extractionValidation.method: Direct byte comparison while copying each installed renderer file.
